text_block_list.text:
During a break. I spotted an Umamusume in the park
being chased around by a bunch of kids.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ohoho! Catching up to me is
ten billion years too early for you!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Dammit~~! Princess, one more time!
I ain't gonna lose next round~!

text_block_list.name: Boy B
text_block_list.text:
Next time, let's pincer them!
I'm definitely gonna catch 'em!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I shall face you properly as a princess.
Catch up to me if you can!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Hold on a sec~~!!
It was a one-versus-many game of tag. Yet she leaped clean over the swings and scaled the jungle gym, darting in every direction with absolute freedom.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Haah, haah.
Fufun, you girls still have a long way to go.

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
No fairrr! Princess sis, you're older,
so go easy on us!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A princess never cuts corners, under any circumstance.
If you're frustrated, you ought to use your head more next time.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
With wisdom, courage, and a 'strong arm'!
There is no problem in this world that cannot be solved.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Don't you think so? Trainer over there!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, you there, the expert running instructor!
Come now, offer some advice to the children!

Even so, challenging an Umamusume to a footrace
would be far too reckless, so—
choice_data_list: Switch who's "it" for the next round!
Why not give them a bigger handicap?

text_block_list.text:
If all the kids run in different directions,
even she will have her hands full trying to catch them.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I am a princess, so being called an ogre is rather...
Well... But――

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A true princess's worth lies in bagging
herself a proper prince, after all!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Now that it's decided, I shall round you all up at once.
Now, let me count. Oooone, twoooo—

Counting all the way to ten, she tore after
the children like a whirlwind, rounding
them up one by one!

I suggested adding a rule:
"Even without touching, stepping on their shadow counts as a win."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
My... Such modest devotion, wishing only
to touch the princess's shadow! How wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Very well! The tale of a knight who pursues
her princess to the ends of the earth is most definitely valid!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Now then, try and catch me if you can!

Saying that, she gallantly dashed off, seemingly planning
to use tree shade to prevent anyone from stepping on her shadow.
